91166.overview: Casino Blackjack allows up to five players to play blackjack against a virtual bank. Players play in turns and can bet, hit or fold, double down (double the bet, but only receive one extra card), insurance bet (when the dealer starts with an ace) and split pairs. The players can also count cards, because the game remembers which cards have been used. After a certain number of hands the deck is shuffled again, or the player can order it to be shuffled at any time.

95413.overview: Avenger (or VIC Avenger as the VIC version is known as) is a Space Invaders variant. The player has to defend Earth from endless rows of attacking aliens. Flying saucers can be shot for extra points. Was later ported to the C64.

164127.overview:
Radar Rat Race takes the gameplay of Rally X and puts it into a rodent context. You control a rat, who must grab all the pieces of cheese in a maze, and flee from all the other rats. Once you reach a barrier in the maze, you are automatically rotated, but you can always manually change direction.

There are red ones who chase after you, and black ones who are activated when you get close to them - both types kill you on contact. When they are close, you can activate a Star Screen to block them off.

The Radar of the title is on the right of the screen, and shows you where each piece of cheese is, although the actual maze is not illuminated, so your next snack might be further away than you think.

164131.overview: VIC Backgammon a computerized version of the popular board game, and was released in 1982 by Bug-Byte Software.

164170.overview: Vegas Jackpot is a simulation of the gambling fruit machine. The player tosses the coin in the slot of the video machine and starts to spin the reels, waiting for the winning combination to appear for a single-pay line. To increase the chances, it is possible to hold certain reels or to nudge them for a certain number of times when it is allowed. The goal of the game is to win jackpots. The amount of reels in the video machine is equal to three for ZX Spectrum, BBC / Electron and Dragon 32/64 versions, and to four for other versions.

164172.overview: Vegas Jackpot is a simulation of the gambling fruit machine. The player tosses the coin in the slot of the video machine and starts to spin the reels, waiting for the winning combination to appear for a single-pay line. To increase the chances, it is possible to hold certain reels or to nudge them for a certain number of times when it is allowed. The goal of the game is to win jackpots. The amount of reels in the video machine is equal to three for ZX Spectrum, BBC / Electron and Dragon 32/64 versions, and to four for other versions.

164173.overview: A vocabulary quiz that feels like fun! Part of the Teach & Test series for ages from 5 to 8.

164174.overview:
Villain is a 1-player arcade game for the VIC-20.

Today's life of crime isn't all high living and a villa in Brazil you know. These days a crook has to be in top physical shape to escape from the fuzz, especially around Pinner Way where P. C. Plod has his beat. Recently, he's become a real pain. He always seems to be able to keep up with you, however fast you run. He's making a life of crime sheer hard work.

To escape P. C. Plod, the player must rapidly move their joystick left and right. The player can also jump, throw vacuums, or throw diamonds. At the start of each job, the player has a training session where they have 3 attempts to complete a 200 yard dash in the displayed time frame. This section can be skipped if deemed too difficult. During the actual theft, the player must stay ahead of P. C. Plod for 1000 yards. While doing this, they must jump over or use their vacuum on objects to clear their path. If the player hits an obstacle or is caught by P. C. Plod, they lose a life.

The player can jump to grab treasure. If they jump and grab a bomb, they are temporarily filled with adrenaline and can run faster and jump higher. If the player accidentally grabs an alarm bell, surveillance floaters known as Big Eyes appear. These can be removed by throwing diamonds. Master Big Eyes resistant to diamonds appear after level 10.

164176.overview:
VIC Panic is a clone of Space Panic.

You have to trap monsters by digging holes and hope they fall into them and then you smash them with your shovel till they fall.

You have limited oxygen, so you should try to win a level before your oxygen is running out.

164210.overview:
VIC Bowling is a 1-player bowling game for the VIC-20.

The numbers 1 - 7 are present in 2 columns at the left of the screen, and the player selects a 1st and 2nd number to set the start and direction of their bowling ball. The player has 2 balls per frame, and there are a total of 10 frames.

165213.overview: Use thruster control to land the spaceship on the surface of Jupiter. Fuel consumption and speed readings are important for the player to determine how to land the craft. Choose from three landing pads of varying difficulty. Easiest landing pad multiplies the player's score by 2, hardest by 10.

166338.overview: The Count of Monte Cristo was eventually consumed entirely by his drive for revenge. Count Cristo, on the other hand, is merely the victim of a Voodoo curse an enemy hexed him with... an external plague more possible to reverse. Starting the game standing over his coffin, you wander the length and breadth of his castle in pursuit of a recipe and the verbal and material components needed to cast an antidote to counter his occult menace. It contains good-luck charms, the sorts of mad scientist chemical concoctions that might well yield a Jekyll-and-Hyde transformation, a flighty medium and her crystal ball, and no small quantity of juju, useful for all sorts of voodoo applications. All that and a chimneysweep trapped in the flue! The player will navigate all these and more with the trademark Adventure International VERB NOUN two-word text parser.

172134.overview: VIC-Men is a maze game similar to Pac-Man published by Bug-Byte Software in 1982.

174622.overview: You are the commander of a spaceship on a journey through our Solar System. The ship has a cruising range of over 1 billion miles and is packed with computerized equipment to help you bring home new and exciting discoveries.

177175.overview: Scramble (also known as VIC Scramble) is another Scramble game for the VIC-20, but with some alterations that make it stand out. As usual, you fly with a ship through a system of caves, but this cave lacks the usual roof. You shoot or drop bombs at the usual missiles, saucers and fuel pods, but in this version, you don't shoot and bomb simultaneously. Bombs are released by pulling back on the joystick with the fire button pressed. Of course, this means that you can't go back and forth as usual, instead your ship is glued to the back of the screen. While the scrolling is forced, pushing forward makes it speed up, so that you can fly away from missiles and other threats. As you go deeper into the caves, the border colour changes.

180573.overview: Bomber is a Blitz variant with some changes made to the original game concept. Like before it is a one-button game where the player has to drop bombs from planes but instead of a city there is instead a canyon full of various objects that has to be hit. This version features three different aircrafts that fly at different heights and appear from both sides of the screen. Unlike previous variants the planes do not get progressively closer to the ground and can not crash. Instead there is a time limit of two minutes and the player's task is simply to clear as much of the canyon as possible before time runs out. The game can be played with or without gravity. The difference is that with gravity bombs will clear more objects if they are dropped from a higher attitude while without gravity there is always only one object being destroyed.

180597.overview: Vixplode is a strategy game played on a 6x6 board. The player and an AI opponent take turns placing counters on the board and it is possible to do so on squares that are vacant or squares that the player already occupies. The aim is to make counters vixplode which happens when the total number of counters on a square equals the number of adjacent squares. Counters will then move over to each adjacent squares which the player then will gain control of. A vixplosion can lead to chain reactions across the board. The game ends when only one of the players has counters left on the board. There are six different levels to play on with different playing abilities of the opponent.

185267.overview: The player controls a small space ship that can rotate 360 degrees, accelerate, and fires directly forwards. The player must destroy incoming spaceships and rogue asteroids. Asteroids break into 2 smaller pieces, which break into 2 smaller pieces before being destroyed. When all asteroids are destroyed, the player enters a new stage with more wandering asteroids.

185334.overview:
Superslot is a 1-player slot machine game for the VIC-20.

A slot machine simulation with graphics and sound. The player inserts 1 - 5 coins, which determine the number of possible lines when they spin the slot machine.

Unlike most other first party games for the VIC, this was not officially released outside of North America, a PAL fixed version however does exist.

185339.overview:
VIC Rescue is a 1-player arcade game for the VIC-20

Your mission is to rescue the 6 stranded people on the planet's surface surface and return them to the orbital station. The orbital station moves slowly across the top of the screen, and the player must choose the correct time to release their landing module to try to sneak through a field of horizontally moving asteroids and land on one of the 2 flat landing pads below. These pads become smaller with each use. The player has limited fuel to slow their descent, which is used throughout all 6 rescue attempts.

After loading a victim, the player tries to return to the the orbital station. At this time the asteroids become enemy ships. The player has the chance to shoot and destroy these, and must reach the opening of the orbital station. This sequence repeats until all rescues are complete or the player loses 3 ships.

199390.overview:
Video Vermin is a 1-player Centipede clone for the VIC-20.

Your once-peaceful garden is being invaded by a horde of hungry vermin. Shoot them, and their fallen bodies sprout a barricade of mushrooms to conceal more swarming raiders. Snails oil a path on which the vermin slither erratically toward you. Dropping butterflies leave a trail of mushrooms in their wake, and pouncing spiders, ants, beetles, and fleas infest the area. One vigilant gardener strikes first. If he's destroyed by the fatal touch of the invaders, two more defenders lie in wait to take his place. If the third gardener succumbs, and you have 10,000 points, another gardener will emerge to help you save the garden from devastation.

205314.overview: The Valley is a graphical roguelike RPG with a simple interface and semi-real-time combat system. The background story is all but non-existent, suffice to say that you're the hero and you want to explore the name-providing Valley to slay monsters and find treasure. The game is played in a turn-based manner, except fighting, which is timed delay. You only have half a second or so to enter your next move. You can attack the monster's head, body or legs, or you can cast one of three magic spells. Of course, some monsters can do the same to you. Finally, you may sometimes surprise a monster, getting a free attack or the choice to retreat (which is not possible in a normal fight).

205326.overview: A cribbage game between you and your computer!

206872.overview:
In 1981 Commodore obtained a license from Namco to release a home version of the hit arcade game Rally-X. But the license only applied to Japan. Since the VIC never sold well in Japan, only a small number of these were released. But since it was a really good game, and not wanting to be limited by their license agreement with Namco, Commodore changed the car graphics to be a cat and mouse and released the game worldwide as VIC-1910 Radar Rat Race.

Use your radar to hit the course checkpoints and shoot for a high score!

Players control a car and dodge pursuing red cars while collecting flags.

Stall the red cars using a smokescreen when they get too close

217033.overview:
VIC 20 Chess is a 1-player versus computer chess game for the VIC-20.

There are 10 levels of difficulty. All commands are via text entry, and pieces are graphically displayed on the screen.

217977.overview:
Video Mania is a shoot 'em up similar to Robotron: 2084. The game is played on a single screen and the player can move and shoot in any direction. Around, alien creatures roam and the player has to shoot them down before they collide with him. The only defence available is a football shaped electronic alien zapper that is thrown at the aliens. However, unlike Robotron, it's played with only one joystick and therefore the player can only shoot in the direction that he is moving.

There are three different enemies. The evil eye which bounces off when hitting a wall, the walwoker which climbs walls when they hit and otherwise move in unpredictable ways and the killerbox which always follows the player. Each killed alien is worth 50 points and once all have been killed a new level is started with a larger amount of enemies. The player starts with three lives and after every 10th level the player gets a bonus life.

218717.overview:
The Vegas Gambler is a slot machine game for the VIC-20.

Each play on the slot machine costs 1 coin, and the player starts with 25 coins. There are multiple ways to win, but only the central row can provide winners. If the player wins 1 coin, they can choose to collect or gamble a higher win, but risk losing everything. At internals, the player gets a second spin, and can chose to hold 1 or 2 of the columns. Game is over if the player loses all coins or breaks the bank.

Released in the July\August 1984 VICTAPE Computing Issue #5.

456517.overview: A clone of Space Invaders for the VIC-20, the object is to destroy four rows of invaders to proceed to the next wave. The invaders will fire shots at you, but you can protect yourself by hiding behind the three barriers that eventually get dismantled by the shots. You have three bases, and once all your bases are destroyed, the game ends. Unique features of the games are its fast speed and the ability to choose the difficulty level.

463085.overview:
VIC Attack! with Breakout are two arcade games for the VIC-20.

In VIC Attack! the player controls a small ship that moves vertically at the left side of the screen and fires to the right. Asteroids and enemy vessels approach, and the player must avoid or destroy them. Every 1000 points the player advances to a more difficult stage. The player starts with 3 lives.

Breakout is a VIC-20 variant of the arcade game, where the player controls a paddle and must bounce a ball to destroy blocks.

463086.overview:
Vicvader is a 1-player arcade game for the VIC-20.

The player controls a small ship at the bottom of the screen that moves laterally and fires forwards. The goal is to earn points by shooting aliens before they reach the bottom of the screen. The aliens march back and forth, and each time they reach the edge of the screen they will drop one row closer to the bottom. Aliens intermittently return fire. Shoot them all to move to the next harder level. If any aliens reach the bottom of the screen it's game over. A flying saucer intermittently moves across the top of the screen for bonus points. Three shields offer protection from alien fire, but also block the player's shots. The player begins with 3 cannons.

463089.overview: Voyager (Lyversoft) is a Strategy game, developed and published by Lyversoft, which was released in Europe in 1983.

463956.overview: In Vic-torian Follies: Adv. 1 - Seaquest the player has to retrieve lost treasure from the bottom of the ocean. The player has a side view of the ocean and can move his ship, The Victorian Rose, left and right along the surface. In his search for treasure he uses a diving bell which can be moved up and down. The treasure is not visible from the start and the player has to use the bell to find it. It beeps when it's getting close. When the treasure is found the screen flashes and the bell automatically picks it up. After that it only has to be pulled up to the ship. Due to the dangers of the sea this might not be as easy as it sounds. Serpents swim around in the ocean and the player has be careful so they don't swim into the bell and its cable. If it hits the bell and the crew inside will be lost. Another problem is the storms which appear in the sky at times. When the clouds are above the ship it won't be able to move.
